title: Home Mortgage Loans: Combined Mortgage Exposure per Borrower
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: Combined Mortgage Exposure per Borrower

Piedmont Crescent Bank limits the total mortgage debt it will carry for any one borrower across all Home Mortgage Loans. This page defines that exposure figure, the ceiling placed on it, and the one way mortgage balances reach beyond the mortgage product.

## Exposure ceiling

A borrower's combined mortgage exposure is the unpaid principal on each of that borrower's loans that is active, delinquent or in forbearance, all added together, and then increased by the amount of the loan now being applied for. That combined figure may not be greater than $5000000.00.

The ceiling is tested on two occasions: when an application is recorded and when a loan funds. On both occasions the balances are taken from the bank's loan records for the borrower, not from figures the borrower supplies.

## What enters the figure

| Item | Included |
|---|---|
| Unpaid principal on the borrower's active loans | yes |
| Unpaid principal on the borrower's delinquent loans | yes |
| Unpaid principal on the borrower's loans in forbearance | yes |
| The loan amount now applied for | yes |
| Loans paid off or applications withdrawn | no |
| Other pending applications of the borrower | no (only active, delinquent and forbearance balances are summed) |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical balances)

- An imagined borrower has active loans with unpaid principal of $3200000.00 and $1000000.00 and applies for $800000.00. The three amounts total $5000000.00, which equals the ceiling without passing it, so the ceiling is respected.
- The same borrower applying instead for $800000.01 would bring the total to $5000000.01, one cent above the ceiling, and the ceiling would not be respected.

The balances and amounts in these cases are invented for illustration.

## Mortgage balances and other holdings

- Mortgage principal is the single lending balance that counts toward the checking relationship balance, and it does so only for those Personal Checking tiers whose own terms include mortgage balances in that relationship balance; which tiers those are is set by the checking product's terms, not by this page.
- No price of any Home Mortgage Loans program depends on what else the customer holds with the bank.
